name: 71753 · Magnolia, AR
findings: ZIP 71753 (Magnolia) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71753 (Magnolia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 71753 (Magnolia) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
